case_title: Charandas Swami v. State of Gujarat & Anr.
aggravating_circumstances: Strong motive for murder, criminal conspiracy, disposal of body, false insurance claim
high_court_outcome: Acquitted accused no. 4 and commuted death sentence to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who were members of the Board of Trustees of a temple, conspired to kidnap and kill the chairman of the temple due to his intention to transfer them for misappropriation of funds. The accused kidnapped the victim and killed him, then disposed of the body to destroy evidence. The body was later recovered and identified through medical examination. The accused also set fire to the vehicle used in the crime and filed a false insurance claim, which was rejected. The prosecution established the victim's last seen with one of the accused, the recovery of the body, and the disposal of the body by the accused. The accused also misled the investigating agencies and had a strong motive for the murder due to financial concerns.
